notes.note: Reviewed the callback-only delta through Fork dialog retries/source-close, Regenerate/Edit attachment resolution, navigation intent, and mobile action callers. Stable wrappers preserve existing request/admission/navigation implementations. Five product-browser cases passed and an injected wrong resend payload failed the real Regenerate assertion before byte-identical restoration passed. No new layout, physical-device, or motion qualification. Existing mixed-Agent wording is not blanket-certified: resend selects the preceding completed answer Agent, or the active Agent for an initial request.
